name: SOC 2 Type II Trust Services Criteria Compliance
description: Compliance framework for SOC 2 Type II audit readiness based on AICPA Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, Privacy), covering continuous monitoring, vendor risk management, and independent CPA auditor evidence packages.

checklists.name: SOC 2 Type II Trust Services Criteria Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for AICPA SOC 2 Type II audit readiness across CC1-CC9 series controls.

items.statement: Tone at the Top and Code of Conduct are communicated annually and acknowledged by 100% of employees (CC1.1).
Background checks are completed for all employees and contractors prior to granting production access (CC1.4).
Automated vulnerability scans are performed weekly and penetration tests conducted at least annually (CC7.1).
Production changes follow documented CAB (Change Advisory Board) approval processes with rollback plans (CC8.1).
Disaster recovery failover test is executed annually demonstrating RTO < 4 hours and RPO < 1 hour.

reviewGates.name: SOC 2 Type II Audit Readiness Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Compliance Officer and Head of Quality Assurance attest that continuous control evidence packages demonstrate operating effectiveness for SOC 2 Type II audit.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the SOC 2 evidence repository demonstrate continuous control operating effectiveness across CC1-CC9?
